The Agency

Where a manuscript becomes a next chapter.

Fox & Brown is a literary and film agency — working across publishing and screenwriting, from autobiography and memoir to the screenplays of a major-studio produced writer.

The agency was founded on the journey of overcoming personal challenges and finding strength in new beginnings — and that founding story runs through everything it does, including a charitable mission that gives a portion of revenue from every project and book purchase to women rebuilding their lives.

From its head office in Belfast to its partners in Los Angeles, Fox & Brown stands for one belief, in print and on screen: empowering voices, changing lives.

Literary

Autobiography, memoir and non-fiction — real lives, powerfully told.

Film

Screenwriting at major-studio level, across almost every genre.

Purpose

A portion of every project's revenue supports women in crisis.

Screenwriting

Michael Tabb

Major-studio produced screenwriter. Twenty-year member of the Writers Guild of America, West. Co-founder and co-creator of the WGA's Mentor Program for the union's newest and most vulnerable members.

A writer for every genre — and every major studio.

Michael Tabb is agile enough to write horror for Universal Studios, family for Disney Feature Animation, a sword-and-sandal war epic for a production company at Warner Brothers, and a thriller released by Sony Pictures — among other projects and genres, including heist, action, adventure, science fiction, fantasy, mystery, crime, swashbuckler, western, rom-com, coming-of-age, drama, and several adaptations.

He cut his teeth working with industry icons including Stan Lee and Dustin Hoffman, and served as a script analyst for Alcon Entertainment — known for producing The Blind Side, Blade Runner 2049, The Book of Eli and Insomnia, which had a put-deal at Warner Brothers.

Michael has also developed projects with Hivemind, Imagine Entertainment, Mandeville Films, Intrepid Pictures, Paradox Studios, Mystery Road Films, and The Canton Company at Warner Brothers.

HorrorFamilyThrillerHeistActionAdventureScience FictionFantasyMysteryCrimeSwashbucklerWesternRom-ComComing-of-AgeDramaAdaptations
  • Lawrence Bender — producer of Pulp Fiction, Reservoir Dogs, Hacksaw Ridge
  • Branko Lustig — producer of Saving Private Ryan, Gladiator, Schindler's List
  • Paul Schiff — producer of Rushmore, My Cousin Vinnie, Young Guns
  • Sean Daniel — producer of The Mummy franchise, Tombstone, The Witcher
  • Jonathan Hensleigh — writer/director of The Punisher, Jumanji, Con Air, Armageddon
  • Mike Newell — director of Four Weddings and a Funeral, Donnie Brasco, Prince of Persia, Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

Having attended USC, NYU, and UCLA, Michael later lectured on screenwriting at Florida State University, UCLA, USC, The Screenwriters World Conference, the Next Generation of Visual Storytellers Conference, and StoryExpo in Los Angeles and New York City.

At StoryExpo he served as the opening keynote speaker for Robert McKee, Christopher Vogler, and John Truby at THE MASTERS OF STORY conference.

With a big heart for mentorship, Michael is the co-founder and co-creator of the WGA's Mentor Program — created for the Writers Guild of America's newest and most vulnerable members, and built over a 20-year membership of the Writers Guild of America, West, the episodic and film screenwriters' labour union in Hollywood.

Charity · The Fox & Brown Mission

Empowering voices, changing lives.

At Fox & Brown, we believe that every story deserves a hopeful next chapter. The agency was founded on the journey of overcoming personal challenges and finding strength in new beginnings — and is now committed to using its platform to help other women write their own stories of resilience.

The mission: supporting survivors of domestic abuse and single mothers navigating crisis situations.

A portion of the agency's revenue from every project and book purchase is dedicated to providing:

Safe Housing

Access to secure environments for women and children.

Essential Resources

Practical aid for immediate stability.

Support Services

Guidance focused on long-term independence and empowerment.

In the UK

Women's Aid · Gingerbread

In the US

Peace Over Violence · Downtown Women's Center

From the head office in Belfast to partners in Los Angeles — every story told through Fox & Brown helps support this mission.
